lines: Morning. The fruit's fresh, and the little thief knows it.
Your mum says today's the day you walk to the gate.
Water's clear today. You can see right down to the weed.
Grey dust on the boats again this morning. Third time this month.
Sweep it at dawn and it's back by noon.
It isn't sand. Sand doesn't smear.
Another one came in to the warden last night. From further out than the last.
Somebody's been asking after the elders, I heard.
The well's never run low. Not once in my life.
You're up early. Off to the gate?
Easy near the pen. The calf's only been here a week.
He's a long way from home. They all are.
Can't stop! He took a whole mango!
Nets, rope, lamp oil. Nothing you'd need for a walk to the gate.
Boats from the outer islands are late again.
Off to the gate at last? Mind the tall grass.
I've sat on this bench forty years. The sea was never this colour grey at dawn.
